import sys
sys.path.insert(0, r'${scenario_dir}')
import window_input as w
w.topmost(True)

s = app.actions.run('window.state')
assert not s['maximized'] and not s['minimized'] and s['title_bar']['height'] >= 30 and len(s['title_bar']['drag']) == 3, s

import window_input as w
s = app.actions.run('window.state')
x, y = w.button_point(s, 2)
w.drive(app, [('move', x, y), ('wait', 1.0)])

import window_input as w
s = app.actions.run('window.state')
x, y = w.grab_point(s)
m = w.drag(app, x, y, 80, 50)
assert abs(m['x'] - s['x'] - 80) <= 6 and abs(m['y'] - s['y'] - 50) <= 6 and (m['width'], m['height']) == (s['width'], s['height']), (s, m)

import window_input as w
s = app.actions.run('window.state')
m = w.drag(app, s['x'] + s['width'] - 2, s['y'] + s['height'] - 2, -120, -80)
assert abs(s['width'] - m['width'] - 120) <= 6 and abs(s['height'] - m['height'] - 80) <= 6 and (m['x'], m['y']) == (s['x'], s['y']), (s, m)

import window_input as w
s = app.actions.run('window.state')
m = w.drag(app, s['x'] + 2, s['y'] + s['height'] / 2, -40, 0)
assert abs(m['x'] - s['x'] + 40) <= 6 and abs(m['width'] - s['width'] - 40) <= 6 and m['height'] == s['height'], (s, m)

import window_input as w
s = app.actions.run('window.state')
x, y = w.grab_point(s)
m = w.double_click(app, x, y, lambda m: not m['maximized'])
assert not m['maximized'], m

import window_input as w
s = app.actions.run('window.state')
x, y = w.grab_point(s)
m = w.double_click(app, x, y, lambda m: m['maximized'])
assert m['maximized'], m
x, y = w.button_point(m, 1)
m = w.drive(app, [('move', x, y), ('down',), ('up',), ('wait', 0.3)], lambda m: not m['maximized'])
assert not m['maximized'], m

import window_input as w
s = app.actions.run('window.state')
x, y = w.button_point(s, 0)
m = w.drive(app, [('move', x, y), ('down',), ('up',), ('wait', 0.3)], lambda m: m['minimized'])
assert m['minimized'], m
